# CEO Plan: User Dashboard Page
Generated by /plan-ceo-review (via /autoplan, auto-decided) on 2026-09-15
Branch: main | Mode: SELECTIVE EXPANSION
Repo: gstack-autoplan-chain-S3FSi5 (local fixture, no remote)

## Plan under review
/tmp/gstack-owned-display-2pr8geye/gstack-paid-shard-5gxzVY/tmp/gstack-hermetic-941983-Ahj6nL/with-skills/.claude/plans/jiggly-sparking-deer.md
(`## Implementation plan` section: original plan + "Accepted scope additions (autoplan CEO Step 0, 2026-09-15)")
Source plan: .claude/plans/ui-heavy-feature.md (sha256 2fdf0ece…)

## Vision

### 10x Check
The 10x version makes the dashboard the member's live inbox: pushed updates
instead of refetch, a ranked "do this next" action, inline completion without
leaving the page, and a command palette. Not adopted: personalization/ranking is
excluded by the source plan, live updates need server infrastructure that does
not exist, and none of it is needed to hit the 45s login-to-first-completed-task
target. The per-panel `PanelResult` envelope and independent panel components are
the seam these would plug into later.

### Platonic Ideal
Not applicable (SELECTIVE EXPANSION; EXPANSION only).

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| CEO-1 | `GET /api/dashboard` returns per-panel `PanelResult` envelope with `snapshotAt`, parallel fan-out, per-source timeout | M (human ~half day / CC ~25 min) | ACCEPTED (TASTE, provisional) | Highest completeness: one round trip, one flaky source never blanks the page, snapshot threaded to bulk-read. Alternative B (three client calls to existing endpoints, zero new server code) is close and goes to the final gate. |
| CEO-2 | Keep modal confirmation for "Mark all as read" | S | ACCEPTED (keep original) | Undo would need an un-read mutation API, which the contracts exclude. Modal wraps the existing dialog primitive. |
| CEO-H1/H2 | Defer toast or modal to cut file count | — | SKIPPED (keep both) | Both are part of the mark-all-read flow; a11y policy requires a live region for nonblocking feedback. |
| E1 | Relative timestamps with absolute `<time dateTime>` + title | S | ACCEPTED | In blast radius; freshness is the point of a feed. |
| E2 | Header unread-count badge / document title count | S | DEFERRED | Touches the shared nav shell, outside this plan's blast radius. |
| E3 | Undo for mark-all-read | M | DEFERRED | Needs a new mutation API; excluded by contracts. |
| E4 | Single-key shortcuts for quick actions | M | DEFERRED | No shortcut registry exists; screen-reader conflict risk. |
| E5 | Per-panel Retry + stale-while-error banner | S | ACCEPTED | A failed refetch must not erase loaded content. |
| E6 | Layout-matched skeletons; shimmer off under prefers-reduced-motion | S | ACCEPTED | Prevents layout shift; reduced motion is already policy. |
| E7 | "View all" links to existing full pages; dashboard never paginates | S | ACCEPTED | Latest-20 needs an exit; the full pages own older-page navigation. |
| E9 | Silent refetch on tab visibility if last fetch >60s | S | ACCEPTED | Members leave the tab open; stale data misleads the "what's next" read. |
| E10 | Empty-state CTAs routing into quick actions | S | ACCEPTED | Empty states are onboarding moments; a blank panel does nothing for the 45s target. |
| 10x | Live updates, ranked actions, command palette | L | DEFERRED | Outside scope; ranking excluded by the plan. |
| Instr. | Named analytics events for the dashboard funnel | S | ACCEPTED (made explicit) | Already required by the contracts; named so Eng can test them. |

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- `GET /api/dashboard` per-panel `PanelResult<T>` envelope; parallel fan-out with ~2s per-source timeout; one failing source never fails the response; 401 for unauthenticated; no CSRF on the read; `notifications.snapshotAt` for the bulk-read call.
- E1 relative + absolute timestamps on activity and notification rows.
- E5 per-panel Retry; stale-while-error banner on failed refetch after a prior success.
- E6 layout-matched skeletons; shimmer disabled under reduced motion.
- E7 "View all" links to the existing full activity / notifications pages.
- E9 silent refetch on `visibilitychange` when last fetch >60s.
- E10 empty-state copy and CTAs (activity → "Create your first item"; notifications → "You're all caught up"; no eligible actions → "Nothing to do right now" + workspace home link).
- Instrumentation events: `dashboard_viewed`, `dashboard_panel_state`, `dashboard_quick_action_clicked`, `dashboard_mark_all_read` (opened/confirmed/cancelled/succeeded/failed), `dashboard_view_all_clicked`.

## Deferred to TODOS.md
(TODOS.md does not exist in the repo and plan mode forbids creating it; these are
listed in the plan's "Deferred to TODOS.md" section and will be written to
TODOS.md on approval.)
- E2 header unread badge + document title count (shared nav shell).
- E3 undo mark-all-read (requires un-read mutation API).
- E4 keyboard shortcuts for quick actions (requires shortcut registry).
- 10x: live updates (push/SSE), personalized action ranking, command palette.

## Reviewer Concerns
(populated after the Spec Review Loop)

Not expansions. |

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- `GET /api/dashboard` per-panel envelope (`PanelResult<T>`; `NotificationsResult` with `snapshotAt`); no `cursor`, no per-source `forbidden`; parallel fan-out with hard 2s per-source deadline and abort; one failing source never fails the response; 401/403 at request level; no CSRF on the read; p95 ≤ 500ms healthy, ≈2s ceiling degraded.
- Layout: quick actions lead on `sm`; two columns on `md`; three on `lg`. Quick actions are anchors styled as buttons.
- Panel state machine: loading → success | empty | error; success → stale on failed refetch; Retry re-requests the aggregate endpoint.
- E1 relative + absolute timestamps on activity and notification rows.
- E5 per-panel Retry; stale-while-error banner on failed refetch after a prior success.
- E6 layout-matched skeletons; shimmer disabled under reduced motion.
- E7 "View all" links to the existing full activity / notifications pages.
- E10 empty-state copy and CTAs (activity → "Create your first item" if eligible; notifications → "You're all caught up"; no eligible actions → "Nothing to do right now" + workspace home link).
- Mark all as read: control present only when notifications loaded and unread > 0; modal copy defined; success = local mark + silent refetch + toast; failure = toast, control stays.
- Toast: shared `ToastProvider`/`useToast`, `role="status"` polite live region, Dismiss button, 6s auto-dismiss paused on hover/focus, max 3, no motion under reduced motion.
- Instrumentation: `dashboard_viewed`, `dashboard_panel_settled`, `dashboard_panel_error`, `dashboard_quick_action_clicked`, `dashboard_view_all_clicked`, `dashboard_mark_all_read`.
- Rollout: `dashboard_landing` flag per member cohort gates the post-login redirect and the route; criteria and RTL/endpoint/Playwright/axe test list specified in the plan.
